description: e2e: heap-backed String fields on a thrown `error` must round-trip cleanly without UAF.  Original regression (pre-Slice 7b) was for `drift_dv_string` missing retain on DV-attachment.  Slice 7b retired the DV path; the contract now lives on `_emit_diagnostic_owning_throw`'s explicit DropValue after the synthesized `to_json_text` call (otherwise the Path-A struct local leaks across throw propagation).  Test still pins the no-UAF / no-leak end-to-end shape — exit 0 = three throw/catch round-trips clean.
